Every rule cites its docs/CONFORMANCE-FINDINGS.md entry; status: capture = recording-closure limitation, deviation = DEVIATIONS.md-registered behavior, open = ledger-tracked port lead awaiting its fix. Rules match first-hit in order — keep specific rules above general ones. The runner prints per-rule hit counts every run: a rule whose count jumps an order of magnitude is a signal, not a mask.
